mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift to monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and reducing the present value of future cash flows, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in rate hike periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 200,000 over 3 months indicates a weakening labor market, which reduces growth expectations and compresses discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in labor weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) below 150,000 over 3 months signals a strengthening labor market, which raises growth expectations and compresses discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in labor strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 over 3 months indicates contracting domestic manufacturing capacity, which compresses discount rates and reduces growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110 over 3 months signals expanding manufacturing capacity, which compresses discount rates and raises growth expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in retail sales (GDPC1) above 200 billion chained 2017 dollars over 3 months indicates robust consumer demand, which compresses discount rates and raises growth expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in demand expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (GDPC1) below 180 billion chained 2017 dollars over 3 months signals weak consumer demand, which compresses discount rates and reduces growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in demand contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
